source_discriminator.source_interpretation: Asp40Asn changes the base to solution hydroxide and makes reketonization strongly rate-limiting; the authors exclude it from their same-mechanism field-rate model.
source_discriminator.interpretation_origin: Fried2014 cites reference67; this run has not independently reviewed that underlying mechanistic study.

underlying_mechanistic_reference.scope: SI reference67 title uses D38N, whereas this spectroscopy construct is D40N. Exact homolog/numbering and construct transfer is unverified; source citation is not a direct D40N observation.

source_discriminator.measured_probe_change_scope: Natural-abundance carbonyl frequency differs by6.1cm^-1 from the printed WT and D40N means; main text rounds to6. No equivalence or unchanged-field claim. Central-value subtraction only; no propagated uncertainty or significance.
source_discriminator.turnover_scope: TableS2 compiles positive kcat0.018s^-1 forD40N versus24300s^-1 forWT; original assay matching remains unresolved.
source_discriminator.field_only_prediction_scope: D40N in this source-assembled comparison; no prediction of a class of unmeasured base mutants.

signed_field_context.source_locator: main paragraph after Tyr16/Asp103 mutant discussion

field_calibration.scope: Solvent frequencies with MD-computed solvent fields; mixed nonsulfated19NT and sulfate-in-water probe contexts. Not direct transition-state field measurements.
field_calibration.extrapolation: WT frequency lies beyond the solvent calibration range. SI reports a quadratic estimate-129MV/cm,10.4percent below the linear estimate.
field_calibration.field_sign: Signed projection retained as reported; no magnitude normalization or causal field reconstruction.

source_regression.endpoint: apparent kcat-derived activation free energy, not directly measured elementary-step barrier
assumptions: same electric field in substrate and transition state
kcat is a reasonable proxy for enolization in selected variants
source_regression.limits: SI23 explicitly allows partially limiting reketonization/product release in WT; microscopic rates are not available across this variant panel.
source_regression.field_axis_unit: kcal mol^-1 D^-1; signed projected field

original.quantity: electrostatic fraction of total barrier reduction
original.basis: extrapolated zero-field reference and chosen aqueous acetate comparison; author estimate, not observed component energy
original.uncertainty_scope: Author-reported model uncertainties; not uncertainty in a directly measured component energy.

technical_comment.objection: Water electrostatic stabilization contributes to the aqueous reference; reference-state accounting changes the assigned fraction. Its thermodynamic estimates are also assumptions.

author_response.inspection: unreviewed; attempted PMC response returned a browser challenge, not article body

interpretation_dispute.adjudication: Preserve competing source interpretations. Neither percentage is an atlas-endorsed causal fraction; do not average or select by agent agreement. The observed variant-specific probe frequencies and compiled rates remain usable at their exact scope.

limitations: No same physical sample, exact full sequence or matched kinetic conditions established.
The protein probe is19-nortestosterone sulfate; turnover substrate is5-androstene-3,17-dione. Main19NT shorthand does not erase sulfate.
Compiled kcat values are not newly measured kinetics, microscopic enolization rates or directly measured barriers.
The D40N mechanism explanation is source interpretation with an unreviewed underlying reference.
No direct reacting-state electric field, global causal partition, prospective design rule, geometry tolerance, new experiment or independent validation.

source_conflicts.source_locator: main Tyr16Phe paragraph versus SI TableS2
source_conflicts.scope: Main approximately10^4 loss is not the quotient of the compiled TableS2 kcat values24300 and12. Do not silently attach the prose factor to those rows or repair either source statement.

source_conflicts.source_locator: Main Figure3B caption and signed horizontal axis
source_conflicts.scope: The prose/caption uses magnitude notation, while the plotted field axis is negative. Retain the signed projected convention used by the reported positive slope; do not silently interpret the model as a positive-magnitude equation.
